title: Build architecture-specific release artifacts in CI
description: Update CI/release automation to produce one verified immutable artifact per supported architecture without building on the target VPS.
acceptanceCriteria: CI builds the application once per supported artifact architecture or uses a reproducible cross-build matrix
The artifact includes standalone server, embedded public/static assets, forwarder/runtime inputs, manifest, and checksum
The release job uploads the same artifact bytes that were tested and does not silently publish a separate untested archive
The workflow fails if artifact inspection or checksum verification fails

steps.details: Create a lightweight fixture/test that checks the release workflow references the staging, inspection, manifest, and checksum stages for every required architecture.
Refactor `.github/workflows/release.yml` to build and inspect architecture-specific artifacts while preserving version, tag, and Docker behavior where compatible.
Upload exactly the inspected artifact, manifest, and checksum as release assets using immutable versioned names.
Run a YAML parser or repository-provided workflow validation if available, then run the focused workflow fixture.

technicalNotes: Use least-privilege permissions and pin actions to commit SHAs where practical. Do not publish or tag from this planning task.
